text.description_html:
Adams Rite MS1861-02, Two-Point Locking Deadbolt for Bottom Rail of Store Doors

The Dual Locking Bottom Rail Deadbolt is usually used on storefront doors where the stile does not have enough room for a standard vertical lock or on glass doors that don't have a stile at all. Instead, this deadbolt is installed on the bottom of a door and locks into the threshold with another bolt that can be used to increase security by locking at two places or to secure double doors together. A Grade 1 Lock, it accepts standard 1-5/32 inch diameter Mortise Thumbturns and Mortise Lock Cylinders.

Also Available Narrow Stile Bottom Rail Deadlock

Features of the MS1861 Bottom Rail Deadbolt:

  • ANSI Grade 1 Lock.
  • Non-Handed
  • Key can be removed only when bolt is in a positively locked or unlocked position.
  • The Bottom Rail Deadbolt can be used with with any standard 1-5/32” mortise cylinder from either (or both) sides. The Cylinder must have MS dimensioned cam.
  • The case is made from steel with corrosion-resistant plating.
  • Bolts are made from hardened steel.
  • Comes packaged with machine screws. Cylinders and/or thumbturns are Sold Separately.

Specifications of the MS1861-02 Bottom Rail Deadbolt with Vertical and Horizontal Bolts:

  • Finish: Zinc Plated Steel
  • Backset: requires placement of cylinder centerline 5-3/4" from nose of door. Cylinder is centered 1-7/8" above bottom edge of door.
  • Case Dimensions: Width - 1", Length - 6", Depth - 1-13/16”
  • Vertical Latchbolt: Diameter - 3/8", Throw - 13/16"
  • Horizontal Latchbolt: Diameter - 3/8", Throw - 1-1/8"
  • Adams Rite 1861 Installation Template and Dimensional Diagram (PDF)

Sold Individually
